nodes.name: Alert Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives production alerts from monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, UptimeKuma).

nodes.name: Normalize Alert
nodes.notes: Normalizes alert payload from various monitoring tools into a standard format (alert_name, severity, description, service).

nodes.name: Build Claude Body
nodes.notes: Builds the Anthropic API request body safely in JS. Asks for SUMMARY + detailed investigation format.

nodes.name: Claude Investigation
nodes.notes: Calls Claude Sonnet for alert investigation. Timeout 120s, retries 3x with 5s backoff.

nodes.name: Build Issue Body
nodes.notes: Formats the investigation with AI header, bold summary sentence, and collapsed full details. Labels issue as incident + intent.

nodes.name: Create GitHub Issue
nodes.notes: Creates a GitHub issue with the alert investigation. Labels: incident, intent.
